premises.text: In-person, naming a manager on a guide card and showing social reach creates pressure to resolve a problem before a public gripe
premises.evidence_span: you can put in the name of the manager that you're speaking with

premises.text: Users can start a gripe with what happened, photos, and a clear ask for how the merchant can help
premises.evidence_span: we ask you how can they help, how can they resolve your gripe

premises.text: Gripes spread virally to Facebook/Twitter followers with a permanent public URL and growing view counts
premises.evidence_span: the gripe is sent to your followers and your friends on Facebook and Twitter

premises.text: Merchants are emailed to claim the account and resolve the known ask, turning detractors positive when marked resolved
premises.evidence_span: when the customer marks the gripe as resolved, the top of this screen becomes green

premises.text: Online influencers gain real-world leverage from their clout when confronting unresponsive service staff
premises.evidence_span: never really get the respect we deserve as we walk around in the real world

value.text: Get customer complaints resolved and turn complainers into happy customers
